text.description_html:
Weslock 2175-2109, Antique Brass Colonial Double Cylinder Handleset

With a solid brass exterior, the Double Cylinder Colonial Handleset features a textured antique brass finish. It has just enough beautiful details to make it a point of interest for your door while adding an early American style to your home. It comes with your choice of inside handle style. Double cylinder handlesets are usually used on doors located by windows because the deadbolt is operated by a key from the inside and the outside. Easy to install, it will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from both the exterior and the interior while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Also available matching:
Colonial Single Cylinder Handleset
Colonial Dummy Handleset
Colonial Dual Keyed Double Cylinder Handleset

Features of the Weslock Double Cylinder Colonial Handleset:

  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 Grade 2 lock standards.
  • The extra large interior thumbturn makes this handleset ADA recommended.
  • Solid brass exterior.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers that prevent sawing.
  • Removable knobs prevents scratching during installation.
  • Fits doors prepared with standard 2-1/8" top, 2-1/8" bottom cross holes, and 1" edge hole.
  • 5-1/2" minimum center to center cross hole spacing
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Limited Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Traditionale Series Double Cylinder Colonial Handleset:

  • Finish: Antique Brass
  • Exterior Handle Length: 18"
  • Exterior Handle Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The finish for the inside knob you choose will be Antique Brass to match the handleset.
